entries.item.fishing-net.name: Fishing Net
entries.item.fishing-net.short: A net for catching fish and quick enemies.
entries.item.fishing-net.goodIf: Good if you like being by the water.
entries.item.fishing-net.explain.what: A knotted net with weights along the edge.
entries.item.fishing-net.explain.table: Throw it over an enemy, and they can barely move for 1 minute. In the evening, you catch your dinner with it.
